title: Astro Dash
description: Race through a space station as an astronaut. Switch lanes, jump obstacles, collect energy orbs.

title: Breakout
description: Break all the bricks with your paddle and ball. Don't let the ball fall!

title: Flappy Bird
description: Tap to flap through the pipes. Simple controls, hard to master.

title: Memory Match
description: Flip cards and find matching pairs. How fast can you clear the board?

title: Snake
description: Classic snake game. Eat the food, grow longer, don't hit the walls or yourself.
